algorithm: {**The proposed algorithm, called "Modified Random Search with Dynamic Step Size", iteratively generates random candidate solutions, clips them to the bounds, evaluates their fitness, and updates the step size dynamically based on the ratio of successful steps to total steps taken so far.**}
{This is a modified version of the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) algorithm with an added clip operation to bound candidate solutions within the specified range.}
